modernity.evidence: Full-bleed gradient hero with a large light headline and a spaced uppercase kicker; minimal layout.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Kicker, headline, subline and white button stack clearly; the stats row below is easy to scan.

mobile_usability.evidence: Hero text and a full-width "Check availability" button fit the phone; nav links hidden with no menu icon.

readability.evidence: White text over the gradient reads well, though the spaced-out uppercase kicker is small.

imagery_quality.evidence: Hero is an abstract gradient with a sun circle; no photos of the villa or pool are visible.

trust_signals.evidence: 4.9 star rating from 146 stays, a quoted guest review, "since 2012" and a contact line.

cta_clarity.evidence: High-contrast white "Check availability" button with a secondary "View rates" link.

brand_consistency.evidence: Teal palette and spaced wordmark carried from the hero into the stats numbers.

summary.en: Clean, modern villa page with a strong availability CTA and clear key facts. It relies on an abstract gradient instead of real photos of the property.
summary.fr: Page de villa moderne et épurée, avec un appel à l'action clair pour les disponibilités et des chiffres clés lisibles. Elle utilise un dégradé abstrait au lieu de vraies photos de la propriété.
